provenance.spatialResolution: Statewide aggregation derived from interpolated surface station observations
provenance.publicationDateEvidence: Supplied package manifest and NOAA source filenames
provenance.qualityFlag: Passed recorded statewide series checks; no source flags are provided in the transcriptions.
provenance.licenseOrAttribution: Credit NOAA NCEI nClimDiv v1.0.0. Source excerpts supplied in project archive.
processingSteps: Validate state and element code, increasing year sequence, month count and numeric range.
Convert published Fahrenheit means to Celsius and inches of precipitation to millimeters.
Average the 30 matching calendar months for each 1981–2010 statewide baseline.
Subtract the baseline from each corresponding observation. Round app data to six decimal places.
